_doc: The intended run profile the pre-run gate (scripts/prerun_gate.py) holds the next VM run to. Change it ON PURPOSE, in the same commit as the vm_lib.sh / code change it describes: the gate fails when vm_lib.sh exports a value this file does not declare, when a module the run never imports is not listed below with a reason, when a whole-file json load appears in the run path that is not listed below, or when the memory projection crosses the kill line. Audit 2026-10-09 (pipeline_gate).
description: Oracle VM full run, FORECLOSURE_ROLE=vm, launched with vm_run.sh --stop-before-publish under a pinned commit; published after review with vm_resume.sh --publish-only.

flags_notes.VISION_PROVIDER: vm_lib.sh picks gemini when a Gemini key file exists, else anthropic; the declared value is vm_lib.sh's text default
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_STREETVIEW: exported only when a maps key file exists (free tier clamp 9,000/month)
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_NC_HARRIS_ROD: browser-rendered register platforms stay OFF until a run has measured their memory and time (HANDOFF item 82)
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_GENERIC_ROD_BUDGET_S: the generic register pass's own budget (enrichment_generic_rod); it only applies in full once main.py runs generic_rod under its own _await_capped (audit 2026-10-09 additions_verify wiring), before that the ROD group's 900 s cap still cancels it (its counts are then logged as generic_rod.cancelled)
flags_notes.GENERIC_ROD_COUNTY_CONCURRENCY: register counties read side by side; each county is its own host and the adapters hold a per-host lock, so never two requests on one host
flags_notes.OBITUARY_LOOKUPS: live obituary name lookups (Echovita / Find a Grave) per dead-owner lead: OFF until the owner decides (HANDOFF item 82)
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_MECKLENBURG_DELINQUENT: Mecklenburg delinquent XLSX (one-year balances, +29k rows, +12 min geocoding): OFF by the 10/7 decision (vm_lib 9edff1f3)
flags_notes.RICHLAND_PARCEL_MAX: Richland map-viewer lookups per run (one host, about 4 s a row, inside RESOLVER_PHASE_MAX_SECONDS 2,400); HOT and WARM rows first

GRANDFATHER_CARRIED.why: main.run json.loads the whole prior plain board (4.1 GB at 350K rows) and keeps a second 350K-Listing snapshot: certain watchdog kill; restored rows also skip verification and scoring

FULLRUN_PERSIST.why: a fresh-only board replaces the cumulative one; pulled_sales then reads the whole prior board

FULLRUN_PRIOR_CORRECTION.why: turns off correct_prior_rows (fallback-point parcels, name-derived counties, exemption-claim withdrawal)

SCORE_BOARD_FAIL_SOFT.why: publishes stale HOT/WARM/COLD tiers when scoring fails

VERIFICATION_APPLY.why: refuted and stale verdicts would not remove their signals

FORECLOSURE_CHECKPOINT.why: no checkpoint: a crash costs the whole run and the gated publish has nothing to publish

ENRICH_PHASE_MAX_SECONDS.why: overrides every _await_capped / _gather_phases cap, including dot_ocr, rod_chain and nc_rod_render whose own budgets main.py passes as default_s (the 2026-09-23 dot_ocr zero-visibility bug)

memory._growth_doc: next run's rows = prior board rows x growth_factor. The 10/6 run grew 223,832 -> 350,013 (x1.56) when the 10/7 sources landed; 1.15 assumes no new source of that size. Raise it when adding sources.

calibration.note: gated full run, exit 0, no swap used

memory._killed_doc: vm-run-20261007T233726 and vm-run-20261008T003844 were stopped by the watchdog at 25,629 / 25,606 MB 36 minutes in, in carryover (json.loads of the 4.1 GB prior board); fixed by d42058b3. Not calibration points: a defect, not a per-row cost.

handoff._doc: dir is the sharded hand-off (manifest.json + one JSON Lines shard per source) since 2026-10-09; file is the legacy single file, read as a fallback. The age is the newer of the two.

repo_size._doc: scripts/repo_size_check.py limits (prerun_gate repo-size, CI tests.yml job repo-size). The pre-commit gate refuses 95 MiB and GitHub 100 MiB per file; pages.yml stops a deploy at 950 MB and Pages refuses 1 GB.

_frozen_doc: RAW_KEEP keys whose only writers are modules the run never imports (scripts/pipeline_wiring.raw_key_producers, 2026-10-09): their values on the board are whatever a script last wrote. Each needs a wire-or-retire decision; the gate fails on a NEW one.
